criteria.statement: Backend service-secrets ContextVM handlers accept `services/secrets-list`, `services/secrets-create`, `services/secrets-update`, `services/secrets-delete`, and `services/secrets-reveal` aliases emitted by the web ContextVM request builder.
The web service-secrets store returns direct JSON-RPC result payloads and legacy `{status,payload}` envelopes without losing secret metadata.
Service secrets remain ContextVM-only; no REST fallback, fake data, or placeholder production path is added.
